title: Irish Yeast Bread
description: A delicious, crispy crust Irish yeast bread recipe that is simple to make and perfect for sandwiches or toast.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine yeast and lukewarm water.
2. Add sugar, salt, and 2 cups of flour to the bowl, mixing until a shaggy dough forms.
3. Gradually add the remaining 1/2 cup of flour, kneading the dough until it becomes smooth and elastic.
4. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
6. Punch down the dough and shape it into a round or oblong loaf.
7. Place the loaf on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and bake for 35-40 minutes.
8. Remove the bread from the oven and let it cool on a wire rack for 10-15 minutes before slicing.
